title: Microsoft's cloud business speeds up to 48% growth
summary: Microsoft said total sales were about $92.3 billion, up 19%, and that its Azure cloud service grew 48%. That beat the company's own forecast and the 42% growth of the last quarter. Reports say the stock rose about 4% in after hours trading.
why: Azure rents out computer power over the internet, and AI needs a lot of it. Faster growth suggests companies are still spending on AI. Still, after hours moves can fade by the next day.

title: Alphabet's sales climb 25% to about $127.6 billion
summary: Alphabet, the company behind Google and YouTube, said its third quarter sales rose 25% from a year earlier. Profit per share was $2.12. The report came out after the market closed on Wednesday.
why: Sales growth of 25% is fast for such a giant company. Whether the stock rises will depend on how the report compares with what investors expected, and on how much Alphabet plans to spend on AI.

title: The Fed keeps interest rates unchanged, with two votes for a hike
summary: The Federal Reserve left its main interest rate in a range of 3.75% to 4% on October 28. Two members of the committee wanted to raise it by a quarter point. Reports say the Fed's chair also announced that it will hold fewer rate-setting meetings starting in 2027.
why: Interest rates are the price of borrowing money. Rates staying put is calmer than a surprise, but two votes for a hike show some officials worry about prices rising too fast. Higher rates can weigh on fast growing companies, so stocks may stay jumpy.

title: Vertiv sales jump 61% and the company raises its yearly forecast
summary: Vertiv, which makes the power and cooling equipment that keeps data centers running, reported third quarter sales of $4.31 billion, up 61% from a year earlier. Its new orders more than doubled, and it raised its outlook for the full year. The stock closed up about 16% on the day.
why: AI needs huge buildings full of computers, and those buildings need power and cooling. Vertiv sells those parts, so strong sales hint that AI building is still speeding up. Even so, the stock is still far below its 52 week high, and big one day jumps can fade.
